name: Kettlebell (Simple & Sinister)
goal: The full Simple & Sinister protocol with a 50 kg (110 lb) bell

stages.name: Foundation
stages.work: KB deadlift, goblet squat, two-hand swings 5 × 10, shoe get-up then 15 lb get-up; a light S&S-style session with what you own
ready: 10 × 10 two-hand swings with a clean hinge
5 get-ups per side with the 15 lb

exercises.name: Kettlebell deadlift
exercises.cue: Hinge, don't squat: hips back, shins near vertical, flat back.

exercises.name: Goblet squat
exercises.cue: Bell at the chest, elbows inside the knees, heels down.

exercises.name: Two-hand swing
exercises.cue: The hips snap; the arms are ropes. The bell floats to chest height.

exercises.name: Turkish get-up (shoe, then 15 lb)
exercises.cue: Slow. Eyes on the bell. Start with a shoe on the fist, move to the 15 lb once it is smooth.

exercises.name: Prying goblet squat
exercises.cue: Sit deep, push the knees out with your elbows, and rock gently side to side.

exercises.name: Halo
exercises.cue: Circle the bell close around your head, ribs down, glutes tight, no leaning.

exercises.name: One-arm swing
exercises.cue: Hips snap, arm stays loose, and the bell floats to chest height. Switch hands every set.
exercises.note: Start at 5 a set and add a rep to every set once all ten sets feel smooth. Aim for 10 × 10 by the end of the stage. The book's way: one get-up between swing sets.

exercises.name: Turkish get-up
exercises.cue: Eyes on the bell, one move at a time, and pause at each step.
exercises.note: If the 35 lb is not smooth yet, do the first sessions with your 25 lb and move up as soon as it is. Five per side, 10 in all.

stages.name: Simple
stages.work: Full S&S, plus the book's time standard

exercises.name: Prying goblet squat
exercises.cue: Sit deep, push the knees out with your elbows, and rock gently side to side.

exercises.name: Halo
exercises.cue: Circle the bell close around your head, ribs down, glutes tight, no leaning.

exercises.name: One-arm swing
exercises.cue: Hips snap, arm stays loose, and the bell floats to chest height. Switch hands every set.
exercises.note: The Simple standard, as I remember the book: all 100 swings and 10 get-ups in 30 minutes, warm-up not counted. Time one clean session, not every one.

exercises.name: Turkish get-up
exercises.cue: Eyes on the bell, one move at a time, and pause at each step.
exercises.note: For the standard, all 10 get-ups are with the 32 kg bell.

stages.name: Target bell
ready: Full protocol with the 50 kg bell

exercises.name: Prying goblet squat
exercises.cue: Sit deep, push the knees out with your elbows, and rock gently side to side.

exercises.name: Halo
exercises.cue: Circle the bell close around your head, ribs down, glutes tight, no leaning.

exercises.name: One-arm swing
exercises.cue: Hips snap, arm stays loose, and the bell floats to chest height. Switch hands every set.
exercises.note: The standard is all 100 swings with the 50 kg, every one clean. End a set early rather than let your back round.

exercises.name: Turkish get-up
exercises.cue: Eyes on the bell, one move at a time, and pause at each step.
exercises.note: Clear the space around you and know how to drop the bell safely: step away and let it fall to the side. Stop if a get-up stops being smooth.
